TC-20/S02.title: Nursing Home dashboard counts the whole roster and stays live (dev)
TC-20/S02.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts driving the app UI. Judged 10/10. 51 In Today residents + 1 not in today: Today's Visits Total 51 = the stored In Today rows, all 51 listed, the not-in-today resident absent; a resident added live appears (+1 Total / Pending in 0.3 s) and leaves when removed, no reload; the All Residents tab counts 52 and lists the not-in-today resident; back on Today's Visits it is gone.
